test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rectify the following sentence by selecting the correct spelling of the underlined word from the options.

Life is a collection of __ephemerl__ moments.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ephemeral"** means lasting for a very short time. (अल्पकालिक)

 
 
• **Example: **The beauty of the sunset was ephemeral, fading within minutes.
 
 
 
• **"Ephemerl"** is the incorrect spelling of "ephemeral". (अल्पकालिक का गलत वर्तनी)
 
 
• **Example: **Life is a collection of ephemerl moments.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Epmeral **(गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of "ephemeral".

 
 
• **Example:** This is an epmeral moment. (incorrect)
 
 
 
• **Ephameral **(गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of "ephemeral".
 
 
• **Example:** The ephameral nature of the event was surprising. (incorrect)
 
 
 
• **Ephemerl **(गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of "ephemeral".
 
 
• **Example:** Life is a collection of ephemerl moments. (incorrect)
